items.title: Why People Think GTA 6 News Is Coming Imminently
items.summary: Rockstar owner Take-Two will release its next earnings report on August 7, but instead of coming after the market closes at 4 PM ET, the report is being released before it opens that day at 9:30 AM ET. Another unusual element is that the report is coming on a Friday. What does it all mean? We don't know for sure, bu…

items.title: Could Switch 2's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake be squaring up for a GTA 6 head-to-head? Newly sighted amiibo suggest a potential November release
items.summary: It looks like Nintendo could be priming its The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for a November release - just ahead of GTA 6 's highly anticipated arrival - if speculation around a pair of newly sighted amiibo is to be believed. Read more
